title: Convert PDF from RGB to CMYK with Python
summary: A Python tool with GUI and CLI to easily convert RGB PDFs to CMYK format for professional printing.

children.text: I recently built a Python application to solve a common problem in the printing industry: converting PDF files from RGB to CMYK color space.
This tool supports both a graphical user interface (GUI) and a command-line interface (CLI) for batch automation. It requires Python 3.7+ and Ghostscript 10.x to be installed on your Windows machine.
You can find the source code and installation instructions on my GitHub repository: https://github.com/yanguswiradana/rgb-to-cmyk.git
